rules.statement: A party in default shall not be entitled, without the leave of court, to raise any contest or dispute the claim of any other party to the action at the trial.
rules.supporting_quote: Section 25(2) of Partition Law No.21 of 1977 reiterates that a party in default shall not be entitled, without the leave of court, raise any contest or dispute the claim of any other party to the action at the trial.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 25(2) of Partition Law No.21 of 1977
